abstract: This study aimed to decrease the radiation dose to the disease-free testis in postoperative irradiation for seminoma patients. We consider the factors influencing the peripheral dose (PD) of 10MV X-ray radiotherapy to be the distance between the caudal edge of the irradiation field and the measuring point, the size of the therapeutic irradiation field, the thickness of the lead shield laid above and lateral to the disease-free testis, and the thickness of the lateral absorber. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We measured the scattering radiation dose coming from the accelerator head and that due to irradiation volume. We measured these doses using a testicular phantom as the non-diseased testis. RESULTS: Scattering radiation from the accelerator head mainly contributes to PD, whereas the larger the size of the irradiation field the more the scattering radiation from the irradiation volume contributed to PD. PD changed more at the surface of the phantom than at its center. PD at the testicular phantom could be reduced to less than 1% of the therapeutic dose when it was situated more than 5cm distant from the caudal limit of the irradiation field, the lead shield above the testicular phantom was 7.5cm thick, and the lateral lead shield was 2mm thick. CONCLUSIONS: PD is influenced by many factors. It is necessary to clarify the change in PD at the testicular phantom, and it is important to limit the caudal edge of the irradiation field and to lay the lead shield for the attenuation of radiation on the disease-free testis.
abstract_ja: 目的：セミノーマの術後照射において、健側精巣への放射線量を低減すること。対象と方法：10MV X線による放射線療法で健側精巣に生じる末梢線量に影響する因子として、照射野尾側端と測定点との距離、治療照射野の大きさ、健側精巣の上方および外側に置いた鉛遮蔽の厚さ、外側吸収体の厚さを検討した。加速器ヘッドからの散乱線と照射体積からの散乱線を測定し、健側精巣の代わりに精巣ファントムを用いた。結果：加速器ヘッドからの散乱線が末梢線量の主な寄与因子であり、照射野が大きいほど照射体積からの散乱線の寄与が増加した。末梢線量はファントム表面で中心部より大きく変化した。精巣ファントムを照射野の尾側端から5cm以上離し、上方の鉛遮蔽を7.5cm、外側の鉛遮蔽を2mmとした場合、末梢線量は治療線量の1%未満に抑えられた。結論：末梢線量は多くの因子に影響される。健側精巣における末梢線量の変化を明確にする必要があり、照射野の尾側端を制限し、健側精巣に放射線減弱用の鉛遮蔽を配置することが重要である。
